title: Raku and Saggar Firings for Members and Class Participants
source_quote: We primarily fire to Cone 5/6 in electric kilns and occasionally offer Raku and Saggar firings for ornamental work.
evidence_sentence: The home page states the studio occasionally offers raku and saggar firings for ornamental work.
evidence_quote: occasionally offer Raku and Saggar firings for ornamental work
summary: Calapooia Clay occasionally offers raku and saggar firings for members and participants in 5-week classes, though specific dates and registration details are not provided on the website.
how_to_join: Prospective members must take at least two 5-week wheel throwing or handbuilding classes first; experienced potters need an orientation. The studio is currently at capacity but accepts additions to a waitlist.
